name: backupTime
description: Date and time when backup completed (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format)

name: backupType
description: Type of backup performed (FULL, INCREMENTAL, or DIFFERENTIAL)

name: backupSize
description: Human-readable size of backup (e.g., '1.24 GB', '456 MB')

name: databaseIncluded
description: Yes/No indicating if database was backed up

name: filesIncluded
description: Yes/No indicating if files were backed up

name: compressionFormat
description: Compression format used (zip, gzip, tar, tar.gz)

name: backupPath
description: Full file system path to the backup file

name: backupDownloadLink
description: HTTP URL to download the backup file

name: retentionDays
description: Number of days backups are retained before auto-cleanup

name: nextBackupTime
description: Date and time of next scheduled backup
